answer: Since the kernel audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the juniper beacon after the epoch ends and the yarrow nonce differs from the first. Each close, 16% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 39 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
